Excellent place to visit
Jul 2026 • Family
Just enjoyed the tea time at Hotel Peninsula Da Nang and I HAVE to talk about the Royale Lounge ⭐⭐⭐⭐

The lounge is so cozy with a direct beach view. Perfect for chilling in the afternoon with tea and snacks. The food gets refreshed throughout the day from light bites and desserts in the afternoon to evening cocktails.

But what made this stay unforgettable was the Sales Team
Huge thank you to ngan, tien, linh, trang, oanh, and especially nhi 💛

Who be able to help me to take a quick picture and capture the beauty view from 28 floor

In the lounge, ngan & tien welcomed us with the warmest smiles and explained all the lounge benefits. Linh & trang were so attentive always offering refills and remembering what we liked. Oanh & nhi gave us amazing local tour tips for Da Nang.

You can really feel how cared for you are from start to finish. Great hotel + a sales team this warm = definitely coming back!

Highly recommend if you’re going to Da Nang and want to feel genuinely taken care of.
